about: The vetted fonts of Elabora, kept by hand. npm run fonts downloads each package at its version, checks it against the npm registry, copies its files of the subsets below (with their unicode ranges) and its licence into files/ and writes catalogue.json. A language listed by a subset is written with the subsets up to that one: latin-ext languages need latin too. npm run fonts -- --check lists newer versions; -- --update moves to them. Only SIL OFL 1.1 or Apache 2.0 licences: ask the maintainers before adding another one.
